rationale.edition: The changed file list is almost entirely open-source web frontend (web/src/components/**, web/src/lib/**, web/src/plugins/logs/**, web/src/views/**, locales). The only enterprise-owned path is web/src/enterprise/components/billings/plans.vue, and its change is a single decorative alt="" on an image; no backend enterprise paths (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/) are touched. Because the diff spans both the OSS frontend and one enterprise UI file, edition is 'both', though the substance is a cross-cutting OSS accessibility refactor.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The trigger comment is empty and no tests-added/skip label was passed, so there is no explicit opt-out. The change is user-facing: it adds a Monaco Escape keybinding that exits the query editor to the next control, a focus-within ring on the editor, and accessible names (aria-label) for icon-only buttons/tooltips across the UI.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The concrete, testable behavior is the new Escape action 'o2.editor.escapeToNextControl' in CodeQueryEditor.vue (guarded by precondition so it only fires when no suggest/find/selection widget owns the key) plus tooltip-driven aria-label naming for icon-only controls. The existing Playwright spec logs-autocomplete-suggestions.spec.js was updated to guard its own Escape presses against this behavior, confirming it is a user-visible interaction change.
rationale.area: Logs. The behavioral change centers on CodeQueryEditor.vue, the SQL/PromQL query editor used by Logs search, and the touched E2E spec (logs-autocomplete-suggestions.spec.js) lives under playwright-tests/Logs/. Sibling specs (logs-sql-autocomplete.spec.js, monaco-query-prefill.spec.js) are also in the Logs area.
rationale.group: Logs-Features. In the CI matrix, logs-autocomplete-suggestions.spec.js (the spec this change modifies) belongs to the Logs-Features shard (actual_folder 'Logs'), alongside other autocomplete/query-editor specs, so the new or extended spec joins that shard.
rationale.existing_tests: One Playwright E2E spec changed in the diff: tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Logs/logs-autocomplete-suggestions.spec.js (its Escape presses are now guarded by menu visibility). It does not yet cover the new Escape-exits-to-next-control focus behavior, so coverage is partial and the Architect should extend or complement it. The many web/src/**/*.spec.ts files are Vitest unit tests, which are not E2E coverage.
